# <span class="en">Local measures of spatial association</span><span class="zh">局部空间关联分析</span> {#sec-lmsa}

::: {.en}
*Addresses RQ1.* The local statistics are computed by
`scripts/03_lmsa.R` on the whole-period totals of the five variables. The
section first confirms that there is global spatial structure to localise,
then maps local Moran's I and Gi\*, follows local Moran's I year by year, and
ends with the sensitivity of the cluster map to the analytical choices.
:::

::: {.zh}
*对应 RQ1。* 局部统计量由 `scripts/03_lmsa.R` 基于五个变量的整期总量计算。本节先
确认存在可供局部化的全局空间结构,再绘制局部 Moran's I 与 Gi\* 地图,然后逐年追踪
局部 Moran's I,最后检验聚集地图对分析选择的敏感性。
:::

```{r}
#| label: lmsa-prep
#| include: false
lisa <- LM$lisa |>
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(ts_an)[, c("TS_PCODE", "TS", "ST")], by = "TS_PCODE")
lisa_sf <- ts_an |> select(TS_PCODE) |> right_join(lisa, by = "TS_PCODE")

cnt <- function(d, col, cls) sum(d[[col]] == cls)
by_state <- function(v, col, cls, n = 3) {
  lisa |> filter(var == v, .data[[col]] == cls) |> count(ST, sort = TRUE) |>
    head(n) |> mutate(s = paste0(ST, " (", n, ")")) |> pull(s) |>
    paste(collapse = ", ")
}
lc <- lisa |> filter(var == "conflict")
```

## <span class="en">Is there structure to localise?</span><span class="zh">是否存在可供局部化的结构?</span> {#sec-lmsa-global}

::: {.en}
A local statistic decomposes a global one [@anselin1995], so the first check
is whether global Moran's I indicates spatial autocorrelation at all. It is
computed with the same row-standardised queen weights and 999 permutations,
against a one-sided alternative of positive association.
:::

::: {.zh}
局部统计量是对全局统计量的分解 [@anselin1995],所以第一步是检验全局 Moran's I
是否表明存在空间自相关。计算使用同样的行标准化 queen 权重与 999 次置换,备择假设
为单侧正相关。
:::

```{r}
#| label: lmsa-global-code
#| eval: false
lw_q <- nb2listw(nb_an, style = "W")
glob <- lapply(names(VARS), function(v) {
  set.seed(1234)
  m <- moran.mc(ts[[v]], lw_q, nsim = 999, alternative = "greater")
  data.frame(var = v, I = unname(m$statistic), p = m$p.value)
}) |> bind_rows()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-global
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Global Moran's I. Left: whole-period totals of each variable. Right: all conflict events, by calendar year. Every value has a permutation p-value of 0.001, the smallest 999 permutations can give.</span><span class='zh'>全局 Moran's I。左:各变量的整期总量。右:全部冲突事件的逐年值。每个值的置换 p 值都是 0.001,即 999 次置换所能给出的最小值。</span>"
#| fig-alt: "Bar chart of global Moran's I for five variables between 0.45 and 0.56, and a line chart of yearly Moran's I peaking in 2022 and 2023."
#| fig-width: 9.6
#| fig-height: 3.8

g1 <- LM$glob |>
  mutate(lab = VAR_SHORT[var], lab = fct_reorder(lab, I)) |>
  ggplot(aes(I, lab)) +
  geom_col(fill = PAL$conflict, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", I)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.65), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Whole period, by variable", x = "Moran's I", y = NULL) +
  theme_th(10.5)

g2 <- LM$glob_year |>
  ggplot(aes(year, I)) +
  geom_line(colour = PAL$conflict, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(colour = PAL$conflict, size = 2.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", I)), vjust = -1, size = 3.1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.65)) +
  labs(title = "All conflict, by year", x = NULL, y = "Moran's I") +
  theme_th(10.5)

g1 | g2
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Global association.** All five variables are strongly and positively
autocorrelated, with Moran's I between `r sprintf("%.2f", min(LM$glob$I))`
and `r sprintf("%.2f", max(LM$glob$I))`: townships with much conflict tend to
border townships with much conflict. Fatalities are the most clustered, which
is consistent with the deadliest fighting concentrating on a few fronts. The
yearly series adds a time dimension the totals hide. Association rose from
`r sprintf("%.2f", LM$glob_year$I[1])` in 2021 to
`r sprintf("%.2f", max(LM$glob_year$I))` in 2022–2023 and fell to
`r sprintf("%.2f", tail(LM$glob_year$I, 1))` in 2025. Conflict became more
clustered as the Dry Zone front consolidated, and less clustered as new
fronts opened in Rakhine, northern Shan and the south-east, which are far
from each other. Local analysis is warranted for every variable and every
year.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**全局关联。** 五个变量都呈现强烈的正自相关,Moran's I 介于
`r sprintf("%.2f", min(LM$glob$I))` 与 `r sprintf("%.2f", max(LM$glob$I))` 之间:冲突
多的镇区往往与冲突多的镇区相邻。死亡人数的聚集程度最高,这与最致命的战斗集中在
少数几条前线相符。逐年序列补充了总量所掩盖的时间维度:关联度从 2021 年的
`r sprintf("%.2f", LM$glob_year$I[1])` 升至 2022–2023 年的 `r sprintf("%.2f", max(LM$glob_year$I))`,
再降至 2025 年的 `r sprintf("%.2f", tail(LM$glob_year$I, 1))`。随着干燥带前线的巩固,
冲突变得更聚集;随着若开、掸邦北部与东南方向这些彼此相距甚远的新前线打开,聚集度
又随之下降。对每个变量和每一年做局部分析都是有依据的。
:::

## <span class="en">Local Moran's I: clusters and outliers</span><span class="zh">局部 Moran's I:聚集与异常值</span> {#sec-lmsa-lisa}

```{r}
#| label: lmsa-local-code
#| eval: false
local_moran_tbl <- function(x, lw, nsim = 999, seed = 1234) {
  set.seed(seed)
  lm <- localmoran_perm(x, lw, nsim = nsim, alternative = "two.sided")
  lag_x <- lag.listw(lw, x)
  tibble(ii = lm[, "Ii"], p_ii_sim = lm[, "Pr(z != E(Ii)) Sim"], lag = lag_x,
         quad     = lisa_quadrant(x, lag_x, lm[, "Pr(z != E(Ii)) Sim"]),
         quad_fdr = lisa_quadrant(x, lag_x, lm[, "Pr(z != E(Ii)) Sim"],
                                  method = "fdr"))
}
```

::: {.en}
`localmoran_perm()` holds each township's value fixed and redraws its
neighbours 999 times from the other 328 townships. Two details matter. The
p-value carried forward is the two-sided simulated one,
`Pr(z != E(Ii)) Sim`; the folded p-value spdep also reports is one-sided
and would halve every p-value. And the quadrant label is built by
`lisa_quadrant()` (in `R/utils.R`) from the signs of the centred value and
its centred spatial lag, so that "High-High" means above the mean in a
neighbourhood above the mean, whatever implementation produced the
statistic.
:::

::: {.zh}
`localmoran_perm()` 固定每个镇区自身的值,从其余 328 个镇区中重抽其邻居 999 次。
有两个细节很重要。沿用的 p 值是双侧模拟 p 值 `Pr(z != E(Ii)) Sim`;spdep 同时报告的
折叠 p 值是单侧的,会使每个 p 值减半。象限标签由 `lisa_quadrant()`(见
`R/utils.R`)依据中心化取值与其中心化空间滞后的符号构造,因此不论统计量由哪种实现
计算,「高-高」都意味着「自身高于均值,且邻域也高于均值」。
:::

```{r}
#| label: fig-moran-scatter
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Moran scatterplot of all conflict events: each township's total against the average of its neighbours. Colour shows the significant LISA class (two-sided p < 0.05).</span><span class='zh'>全部冲突事件的 Moran 散点图:每个镇区的总量与其邻居平均值的关系。颜色表示显著的 LISA 类别(双侧 p < 0.05)。</span>"
#| fig-alt: "Scatterplot of township conflict totals against the spatial lag, with significant high-high townships in red at upper right and low-low in blue at lower left."
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 5.6

ggplot(lc, aes(x, lag)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(lc$lag), colour = "#a8a29e", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(lc$x), colour = "#a8a29e", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.5,
              linetype = "22") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = quad), size = 1.8, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text_repel(data = lc |> filter(quad != "Insignificant") |> slice_max(x, n = 6),
                  aes(label = TS), size = 2.8, min.segment.length = 0) +
  geom_text_repel(data = lc |> filter(quad == "Low-High"),
                  aes(label = TS), size = 2.8, min.segment.length = 0,
                  colour = PAL_LISA[["Low-High"]]) +
  scale_colour_manual("LISA class", values = c(PAL_LISA[1:4], Insignificant = "#d6d3d1")) +
  labs(title = "Moran scatterplot, all conflict events",
       subtitle = sprintf("Slope = Moran's I = %.3f", LM$glob$I[LM$glob$var == "conflict"]),
       x = "Township total, Jan 2021 – Sep 2025",
       y = "Average of neighbours (spatial lag)") +
  theme_th(10.5)
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Reading the scatterplot.** The slope of the dashed line is Moran's I. The
significant High-High townships (upper right) are not simply the largest
totals: Hpakant, among the highest counts in the country, is not significant,
because its neighbours in Kachin are quiet by comparison. Significance
requires a high value *and* a high neighbourhood. Low-Low townships crowd the
lower left, where many townships have few events and so do their
neighbours. Three townships are significant Low-High outliers, quieter places
surrounded by conflict: `r paste(lc$TS[lc$quad == "Low-High"], collapse = ", ")`.
No township is a significant High-Low outlier.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**如何读散点图。** 虚线的斜率就是 Moran's I。显著的「高-高」镇区(右上)并不只是
总量最大的那些:帕敢的计数位居全国前列,却不显著,因为它在克钦的邻居相对平静。
显著性要求**自身高、邻域也高**。「低-低」镇区挤在左下,那里许多镇区事件很少,
它们的邻居也一样。有三个镇区是显著的「低-高」异常值,即被冲突包围的较平静地方:
`r paste(lc$TS[lc$quad == "Low-High"], collapse = "、")`。没有任何镇区是显著的
「高-低」异常值。
:::

```{r}
#| label: fig-lisa
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Local Moran's I cluster maps for the five variables, whole period. Only townships with two-sided permutation p < 0.05 are coloured; a heavy outline marks those that also survive the false discovery rate correction.</span><span class='zh'>五个变量的局部 Moran's I 聚集图(整个研究期)。只有双侧置换 p < 0.05 的镇区被着色;粗描边标出同时通过错误发现率校正的镇区。</span>"
#| fig-alt: "Five maps of LISA clusters. High-high clusters in red over the Dry Zone and the south-east; low-low clusters in blue over the delta, Yangon and eastern Shan."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6.2

lisa_map <- function(v, title = VAR_TINY[[v]], col = "quad", col_fdr = "quad_fdr") {
  d <- lisa_sf |> filter(var == v)
  map_base(
    list(
      geom_sf(data = d, aes(fill = .data[[col]]), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.04,
              show.legend = TRUE),
      geom_sf(data = d |> filter(.data[[col_fdr]] != "Insignificant"),
              fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.42)),
    title = title, state_lw = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual("LISA class (p < 0.05)", values = PAL_LISA, drop = FALSE) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10))
}

wrap_plots(lapply(names(VARS), lisa_map), nrow = 1) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Local Moran's I: clusters and outliers, Jan 2021 – Sep 2025",
                  subtitle = "Heavy outline: also significant after FDR correction",
                  theme = theme_th(11)) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-lisa-counts
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Townships in each LISA class at p < 0.05, and the number that survive FDR correction.</span><span class='zh'>p < 0.05 下各 LISA 类别的镇区数,以及通过 FDR 校正的镇区数。</span>"

lisa |>
  group_by(Variable = VAR_SHORT[var]) |>
  summarise(`High-High` = sum(quad == "High-High"), `Low-Low` = sum(quad == "Low-Low"),
            `High-Low` = sum(quad == "High-Low"), `Low-High` = sum(quad == "Low-High"),
            `Significant` = sum(quad != "Insignificant"),
            `Survive FDR` = sum(quad_fdr != "Insignificant"), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(match(Variable, VAR_SHORT)) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Clusters.** For all conflict events, `r cnt(lc, "quad", "High-High")`
townships form High-High clusters, led by
`r by_state("conflict", "quad", "High-High")`. They make one contiguous block
across the Dry Zone where Sagaing, Magway and Mandalay meet, and a second,
looser chain in the south-east through Kayin to Tanintharyi.
`r cnt(lc, "quad", "Low-Low")` townships form Low-Low clusters, led by
`r by_state("conflict", "quad", "Low-Low")`: the delta and Yangon, and the
eastern Shan hills along the Chinese and Thai borders, including the Wa
self-administered area, where the United Wa State Army has kept out of the
war. The variables differ at the margins. Violence against civilians has the
tightest High-High cluster: all but `r sum(lisa$var == "vac" & lisa$quad == "High-High" & !lisa$ST %in% c("Sagaing", "Magway", "Mandalay"))` of its townships are in the Dry Zone. Explosions
and remote violence add a strong band from eastern Bago through Kayin to Mon,
where shelling and air strikes accompany the fighting along the Thai border.
Battles extend furthest, with High-High townships as far as Kachin, Kayah and
Tanintharyi. `r sum(LM$lisa$quad_fdr != "Insignificant" & LM$lisa$var == "conflict")`
of the `r sum(lc$quad != "Insignificant")` significant townships for all
conflict survive FDR correction. Every High-High township that survives is in
the Dry Zone; the south-eastern chain does not survive the correction, and is
the less certain of the two clusters.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**聚集。** 就全部冲突事件而言,有 `r cnt(lc, "quad", "High-High")` 个镇区构成
「高-高」聚集,居前的是 `r by_state("conflict", "quad", "High-High")`。它们在实皆、
马圭与曼德勒交界的干燥带形成一个连片区块,并在东南方向形成一条经克伦延伸至
德林达依的较松散链条。`r cnt(lc, "quad", "Low-Low")` 个镇区构成「低-低」聚集,居前
的是 `r by_state("conflict", "quad", "Low-Low")`:即三角洲与仰光,以及沿中国与泰国
边境的掸邦东部山地,包括佤自治区,佤联军一直置身战争之外。各变量在边缘处有所不同。
针对平民的暴力「高-高」聚集最紧凑:除 `r sum(lisa$var == "vac" & lisa$quad == "High-High" & !lisa$ST %in% c("Sagaing", "Magway", "Mandalay"))` 个镇区外,全部位于干燥带。爆炸与远程暴力在从勃固
东部经克伦到孟邦的地带额外形成一条强聚集带,那里沿泰国边境的战斗伴随着炮击与空袭。
战斗的分布最广,「高-高」镇区远及克钦、克耶与德林达依。全部冲突事件的
`r sum(lc$quad != "Insignificant")` 个显著镇区中,有
`r sum(LM$lisa$quad_fdr != "Insignificant" & LM$lisa$var == "conflict")` 个通过 FDR
校正。通过校正的「高-高」镇区全部位于干燥带;东南链条没有通过校正,是两个聚集
中较不确定的一个。
:::

## <span class="en">Getis-Ord Gi\*: hot and cold spots</span><span class="zh">Getis-Ord Gi\*:热点与冷点</span> {#sec-lmsa-gi}

```{r}
#| label: lmsa-gi-code
#| eval: false
nb_self <- include_self(nb_an)          # Gi* counts the township itself
wt_self <- st_weights(nb_self)
set.seed(1234)
g <- local_gstar_perm(ts$conflict, nb_self, wt_self, nsim = 999)
gi_class(g$gi_star, g$p_sim)            # sign of Gi* where p_sim < 0.05
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-gi
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Getis-Ord Gi\\* hot and cold spots for the five variables, whole period, two-sided permutation p < 0.05. Heavy outline: survives FDR correction.</span><span class='zh'>五个变量的 Getis-Ord Gi\\* 热点与冷点(整个研究期,双侧置换 p < 0.05)。粗描边:通过 FDR 校正。</span>"
#| fig-alt: "Five maps of Gi* hot spots in red and cold spots in blue, closely matching the LISA high-high and low-low clusters."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6.2

gi_map <- function(v) {
  d <- lisa_sf |> filter(var == v)
  map_base(
    list(
      geom_sf(data = d, aes(fill = gi_class), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.04,
              show.legend = TRUE),
      geom_sf(data = d |> filter(gi_class_fdr != "Insignificant"),
              fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.42)),
    title = VAR_TINY[[v]], state_lw = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual("Gi* (p < 0.05)", values = PAL_GI, drop = FALSE) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10))
}

wrap_plots(lapply(names(VARS), gi_map), nrow = 1) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Getis-Ord Gi*: hot and cold spots, Jan 2021 – Sep 2025",
                  subtitle = "Heavy outline: also significant after FDR correction",
                  theme = theme_th(11)) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
#| label: gi-agree
#| include: false
agree <- lc |>
  mutate(lisa_side = case_when(quad == "High-High" ~ "hot", quad == "Low-Low" ~ "cold",
                               TRUE ~ "none"),
         gi_side = case_when(gi_class == "Hot spot" ~ "hot", gi_class == "Cold spot" ~ "cold",
                             TRUE ~ "none"))
n_same  <- sum(agree$lisa_side == agree$gi_side)
gi_only_hot <- agree |> filter(gi_side == "hot", lisa_side != "hot")
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Hot and cold spots.** Gi\* reproduces the LISA geography closely. For all
conflict events the two statistics put `r n_same` of `r N_TS` townships on the
same side (hot, cold or neither). They disagree where they are built to
disagree. Gi\* includes the township in its own neighbourhood and does not
ask whether the township resembles its neighbours, so a quiet township
surrounded by conflict can be a hot spot: `r nrow(gi_only_hot)` townships are
Gi\* hot spots without being LISA High-High, among them
`r paste(head(gi_only_hot$TS, 4), collapse = ", ")`. For peace-building this
is useful: those are the townships *inside* a zone of violence, whatever
their own count. Gi\* cannot see outliers, which is why both statistics are
reported. After FDR correction the hot spots that remain are in the Dry Zone
core, and the cold spots that remain are in the delta and the eastern Shan
hills.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**热点与冷点。** Gi\* 与 LISA 的地理格局高度吻合。就全部冲突事件而言,两种统计量
把 `r N_TS` 个镇区中的 `r n_same` 个放在同一侧(热、冷或都不是)。它们只在其设计上
就会不一致的地方出现分歧。Gi\* 把镇区本身纳入其邻域,并不追问该镇区是否与邻居相似,
所以一个被冲突包围的平静镇区也可能是热点:有 `r nrow(gi_only_hot)` 个镇区是 Gi\*
热点但不是 LISA「高-高」,其中包括 `r paste(head(gi_only_hot$TS, 4), collapse = "、")`。
这对和平建设很有用:它们是位于暴力区域**之内**的镇区,不论自身计数如何。Gi\* 看不到
异常值,这正是同时报告两种统计量的原因。经 FDR 校正后,保留下来的热点位于干燥带
核心,保留下来的冷点位于三角洲与掸邦东部山地。
:::

## <span class="en">Year by year</span><span class="zh">逐年分析</span> {#sec-lmsa-years}

```{r}
#| label: fig-lisa-years
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Local Moran's I cluster maps of all conflict events, by calendar year (2025: January to September). Two-sided p < 0.05; heavy outline: survives FDR correction.</span><span class='zh'>全部冲突事件的局部 Moran's I 聚集图,按日历年(2025 年:1 月至 9 月)。双侧 p < 0.05;粗描边:通过 FDR 校正。</span>"
#| fig-alt: "Five yearly LISA maps showing the Dry Zone high-high cluster strongest in 2022 and 2023 and shrinking by 2025, while clusters appear in Rakhine in 2024 and in Kayin in 2025."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 5.4

ly <- ts_an |> select(TS_PCODE) |> right_join(LM$lisa_year, by = "TS_PCODE")
map_base(
  list(geom_sf(data = ly, aes(fill = quad), colour = NA, show.legend = TRUE),
       geom_sf(data = ly |> filter(quad_fdr != "Insignificant"),
               fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.3)),
  title = "Local Moran's I, all conflict events, by year",
  state_lw = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~ year, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual("LISA class (p < 0.05)", values = PAL_LISA, drop = FALSE) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(size = 10))
```

```{r}
#| label: year-lisa-numbers
#| include: false
lyc <- LM$lisa_year |>
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(ts_an)[, c("TS_PCODE", "ST")], by = "TS_PCODE")
hh_y <- function(y, st = NULL) {
  d <- lyc |> filter(year == y, quad == "High-High")
  if (!is.null(st)) d <- d |> filter(ST %in% st)
  nrow(d)
}
dz_st <- c("Sagaing", "Magway", "Mandalay")
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Year by year.** The Dry Zone cluster is the constant of the first three
years: `r hh_y(2021, dz_st)` High-High townships in the three Dry Zone
regions in 2021, `r hh_y(2022, dz_st)` in 2022 and `r hh_y(2023, dz_st)` in
2023. From 2024 it thins: `r hh_y(2024, dz_st)` in 2024 and
`r hh_y(2025, dz_st)` in 2025. Of those, three are what is left of the old
core (Pakokku, Yesagyo and Salingyi), and four lie in the north of Mandalay
towards its border with northern Shan (Madaya, Singu, Thabeikkyin and Mogoke,
joined by Nawnghkio across the border). Fighting in the Dry Zone did not
stop; @fig-years shows Sagaing still among the most violent areas. What
changed is that its townships became less distinct from the rest of the
country as Rakhine (High-High in 2024), northern Shan and the south-east
caught up. In 2025 the `r hh_y(2025)` High-High townships are split between
that northern group, the remnant of the core, and the Kayin border, where
`r hh_y(2025, "Kayin")` townships around Myawaddy and Hpa-An form a cluster
of their own. The Low-Low cluster of the eastern Shan
hills is present in every year, the most stable feature of the conflict map.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**逐年。** 前三年里,干燥带聚集是不变的常量:干燥带三个省份的「高-高」镇区在
2021 年有 `r hh_y(2021, dz_st)` 个,2022 年 `r hh_y(2022, dz_st)` 个,2023 年
`r hh_y(2023, dz_st)` 个。从 2024 年起它逐渐稀疏:2024 年 `r hh_y(2024, dz_st)` 个,
2025 年 `r hh_y(2025, dz_st)` 个。其中三个是老核心的残余(木各具、耶沙久与沙林基),
另外四个位于曼德勒北部、靠近掸邦北部边界(Madaya、Singu、Thabeikkyin 与 Mogoke,
以及边界另一侧的 Nawnghkio)。干燥带的战斗并未停止;@fig-years 显示实皆仍是暴力最
严重的地区之一。改变的是,随着若开(2024 年出现「高-高」)、掸邦北部与东南地区追赶
上来,干燥带镇区与全国其余地区的差别缩小了。2025 年的 `r hh_y(2025)` 个「高-高」镇区
分为三部分:上述北部一组、老核心的残余,以及克伦边境一组,后者在妙瓦底与帕安周围有
`r hh_y(2025, "Kayin")` 个镇区自成一个聚集。掸邦东部山地的
「低-低」聚集每年都存在,是冲突地图上最稳定的特征。
:::

## <span class="en">How robust is the cluster map?</span><span class="zh">聚集地图有多稳健?</span> {#sec-lmsa-sens}

::: {.en}
Each alternative below changes one choice relative to the primary run (queen
contiguity with the two island links, raw counts, two-sided p < 0.05) and
counts how many townships keep the same class.
:::

::: {.zh}
下面每个备选方案都只相对主分析(带两个岛屿连接的 queen 邻接、原始计数、双侧
p < 0.05)改变一项选择,并统计有多少镇区保持相同类别。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-lisa-sens
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Sensitivity of the LISA cluster map of all conflict events to the neighbour definition and to the transformation of the counts.</span><span class='zh'>全部冲突事件 LISA 聚集图对邻居定义与计数变换的敏感性。</span>"

LM$sens_summary |>
  rename(Specification = spec) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-lisa-sens
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>The LISA cluster map of all conflict events under the four specifications.</span><span class='zh'>四种设定下全部冲突事件的 LISA 聚集图。</span>"
#| fig-alt: "Four LISA maps comparing queen contiguity, k-nearest neighbours, log counts and density."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 5.4

ss <- ts_an |> select(TS_PCODE) |> right_join(LM$sens, by = "TS_PCODE") |>
  mutate(spec = factor(spec, levels = levels(LM$sens_summary$spec)))
map_base(geom_sf(data = ss, aes(fill = quad), colour = NA, show.legend = TRUE),
         title = "Local Moran's I, all conflict events, four specifications",
         state_lw = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~ spec, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual("LISA class (p < 0.05)", values = PAL_LISA, drop = FALSE) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(size = 9))
```

```{r}
#| label: sens-numbers
#| include: false
sg <- function(s, col) LM$sens_summary[[col]][LM$sens_summary$spec == s]
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Robustness.** The core of the map is robust and the margins are not.
Switching to six nearest neighbours keeps
`r sg("k = 6 nearest neighbours", "HH kept")` of the
`r sg("Primary (queen, raw counts)", "High-High")` High-High townships and
enlarges the Low-Low zone, because large hill townships now borrow
neighbours across state lines. Taking logarithms keeps
`r sg("log(1 + count)", "HH kept")` High-High townships and adds more at the
edges of the clusters, since the transformation shrinks the gap between the
most violent townships and their merely violent neighbours; it shrinks the
Low-Low zone for the same reason. Dividing by area is the one change that
redraws the map, keeping none of the High-High townships: per square
kilometre, the small downtown townships of Yangon, most under 10 km², become
the "hottest" places, and the large rural townships of the Dry Zone drop out.
That variant answers a different question, how concentrated events are on
the ground, and confirms that the count-based hot spots are not an artefact
of township size: they are large townships with a great deal of conflict, not
large townships with average conflict.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**稳健性。** 地图的核心是稳健的,边缘则不然。改用六个最近邻时,
`r sg("Primary (queen, raw counts)", "High-High")` 个「高-高」镇区中保留了
`r sg("k = 6 nearest neighbours", "HH kept")` 个,「低-低」区域扩大,因为大面积的山地
镇区如今会跨越省邦边界借用邻居。取对数后保留了 `r sg("log(1 + count)", "HH kept")` 个
「高-高」镇区,并在聚集边缘增加了更多,因为这种变换缩小了最暴力镇区与其「只是暴力」
的邻居之间的差距;出于同样原因,「低-低」区域缩小。按面积相除是唯一重新绘制地图的
改变,原有「高-高」镇区一个都没有保留:按每平方公里计算,仰光市中心那些大多不足
10 km² 的小镇区成为「最热」的地方,干燥带的大面积农村镇区则退出。这一变体回答的是另一个
问题,即事件在地面上有多集中;它也证实了基于计数的热点并非镇区面积造成的假象:
它们是**冲突极多的大镇区**,而不是冲突一般的大镇区。
:::
